claim_scope_note: The only claim addressed by this packet is C-DELTA-REPAIR (owner_lanes graph/runtime/product, registry status HYPOTHESIS, next_gate 'controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds'). No other claim id may be advanced and no event may be emitted for C-FRESHNESS, C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-MEAS-VALID, C-PRODUCT-ECON or C-CROSSSITE. The result is a bounded, controlled-substrate measurement; it is not a Web-prevalence statement (SB-01) and it does not promote anything to Product Core (SB-05).

director_mandate_binding.binding_strategic_question: Can local delta repair, measured on a controlled credential-free multi-node substrate with an independently verifiable local-perturbation surface, repair the inherited knowledge affected by a bounded local change (blast radius 1-3: a changed field, endpoint, transport validator/token, or permission) at repair cost materially below an honest cold re-derivation under identical per-trajectory counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), while keeping contamination (incorrectly repaired or falsely accepted items) below a preregistered bound and reporting per-family precision/recall and false-accept, so that C-DELTA-REPAIR's registry next gate (controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds) is actually measured rather than re-assumed?
director_mandate_binding.mandate_obedience_note: The mandate's strategic question names 'permission' as one possible bound-1-3 change; on a credential-free substrate (required so that no lane depends on an unavailable model/credential/browser, per the Runtime C-MEAS-VALID dependency) permission/authority-boundary drift is structurally unreachable. This family is therefore declared NOT_APPLICABLE (SB-02) rather than dropped silently; the three reachable families (field, endpoint, transport) plus a legitimate-update control cover the mandate's discriminating core. The mandate's Director rationale explicitly names the shipped src/spider/kernel.py literal-distill blocker (B1) and a prior shared design/design-review control-plane failure (identical fingerprint 3b9ff5e4e9e73f23e368efb4 across all six lanes) as context; this design addresses the latter by supplying a pre-freeze satisfiability certificate (see pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run) and by binding the exact pre-existing verification primitive it depends on in freeze_artifacts.
explicitly_not_authorized: any claim event outside C-DELTA-REPAIR; no C-MEAS-VALID, C-FRESHNESS, C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-PRODUCT-ECON or C-CROSSSITE event
any Product Core promotion or shipped-status change
reusing the parked C-FRESHNESS four-anchor D1V route or any web anchor contact
a claim that repair generalizes beyond the frozen blast radius 1-3 and the frozen family set (SB-06)
any modification of the shipped kernel or of any file listed in freeze.artifact_hashes
agent_priors_used: General prior, not SPIDER evidence: a substrate where the treatment is handed the exact delta collapses repair to the oracle and yields a definitional ceiling (repair==truth, contamination==0); the design must add an observable-ambiguity stratum and a legitimate-update control so precision/recall are non-trivial and the SUPPORTS and FALSIFIES branches remain reachable.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: a comparator that is forced to re-derive the ENTIRE inherited corpus for a single goal is a strawman; the honest cold comparator must re-derive only the minimal procedure+parameters needed for the SAME goal, so that the measured cost ratio reflects a real discovery-vs-repair trade and FALSIFIES is behaviourally reachable.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: the prior distributed attempt failed at the health gate (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 MEASUREMENT_INVALID, substrate_started=false); the design must use a substrate whose prerequisites are already present in the environment rather than pip-installed at EXECUTE time.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: if the comparator is at a floor or the treatment is at a ceiling, no effect is identifiable regardless of sample size, so a pre-freeze non-degeneracy/dynamic-range certificate must precede any benchmark spend.

Its next_question is NOT the objective of this experiment.

A repaired measurement substrate existed: the corrected GATE-C3 predicate and dual independent stdlib extraction paths passed on credential-free GET-only anchors; this design borrows only the general governance lesson (fail-closed substrate certificate) and no anchor.

The anchor-clustered bootstrap estimator is certified capable of non-degenerate and degenerate bounds via a same-code-path positive/null control; this design borrows only the estimator-control PATTERN, not the D1V object.
inherited_rejected: REJECTED (by the parent): constructing a >=2-anchor D1V population from the four frozen C-FRESHNESS anchors under the frozen transport signature.
REJECTED (by the parent): reading single-anchor D1V point estimates as false-accept/blindness/necessity results.
Out of scope for this packet: any C-FRESHNESS status change or anchor contact.

Do not assume the prior single-node repair result (EXP-GRAPH-36018188168) transfers to a multi-node substrate without re-measurement; its deterministic single-node ceiling (contamination 0.0, repair 1.0) is exactly the degeneracy this design must avoid.

Do not assume the prior distributed failure (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 MEASUREMENT_INVALID) was a scientific negative about repair; it was an infrastructure failure, and its leaked default constants (contamination 0.1611, amortized 15/1) must not be cited as repair evidence.
Do not treat the mandate's word 'permission' as measured; on this credential-free substrate it is NOT_APPLICABLE (SB-02).

question: On a controlled, credential-free, stdlib-only multi-node substrate (N=3 independent loopback HTTP origins with disjoint local registries behind one deterministic router) with an independently verifiable local-perturbation surface (blast radius 1-3), across the reachable perturbation families FIELD, ENDPOINT and TRANSPORT plus a legitimate-update control family, can a local delta-repair treatment (T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR) repair inherited knowledge affected by a bounded local change at a measured L1 counter cost (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) materially below an HONEST per-goal cold re-derivation comparator (B-COLD-REDERIVE: empty inherited store, must discover the minimal procedure+parameters for the same goal and read the value) while holding contamination (incorrectly repaired or falsely accepted items) and false-accept below preregistered bounds, keeping per-family precision/recall measured (not assumed), and containing every repair to the independently verified blast radius without mutating a node outside it, so that C-DELTA-REPAIR's next gate is actually measured?
hypothesis: H-MAIN (cost). Over the frozen paired scored suite, M_COST_RATIO = M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE is <= 0.70 with paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound strictly < 1.0, because the treatment inherits the goal's procedure and pays only detection + localization + minimal repair (blast radius 1-3) while B-COLD-REDERIVE re-discovers the procedure from the frozen candidate space and re-establishes the value per episode. H-QUALITY. The treatment holds M_CONTAMINATION <= 0.05, M_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.05, min over families {FIELD,ENDPOINT,TRANSPORT} of M_RECALL_FAM >= 0.90, and M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT <= 0.05, so the cost win is not bought by silent corruption. H-CONTAIN. M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT == 1.0 and M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION == 0.0: every applied mutation lies inside the independently recomputed true blast radius and no node outside it is mutated. H-NONDEGENERATE (design-level). The treatment is NOT handed the exact delta on the scored population: the pre-registered surface-ambiguous stratum of FIELD (a genuine perturbation and a legitimate update that present the same observable value-changed signal) forces the treatment to pay a localization/verification cost, abstain (UNKNOWN) or risk false-repair, so repair is not definitionally the oracle and both SUPPORTS and FALSIFIES regions of the decision rule are arithmetically reachable (spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run).
falsifier: Frozen conditions, each pre-labelled. F-VALID: any blocking measurement-validity gate fails (V02 substrate health/identity; V03 independent perturbation verification; V04 counter-instrumentation consistency; V05 control-channel isolation; V06 raw retention; V07 determinism; V08 frozen-input integrity; V09 credential-free loopback-only; V11 treatment-liveness smoke) -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE, no claim-level statement. F-INSTR: a positive control fails (PC-DETECT-CANARY canary recall != 1.0; PC-COST-CANARY fails to separate B-COLD-REDERIVE from B-LOCAL-ORACLE; PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS fixture mismatch) or a null control is insensitive (B-NOOP-STALE fails to exhibit M_CONTAMINATION > the bound on perturbed items, so the contamination metric cannot detect failure; or B-COLD-REDERIVE fails to reach M_CONTAMINATION == 0, so the metric is stuck) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, INCONCLUSIVE. F-COST (falsifies H-MAIN): M_COST_RATIO >= 1.0 -> LOCAL-REPAIR-NO-WORK-SAVED. F-QUALITY (falsifies H-QUALITY): M_CONTAMINATION > 0.20 OR min family M_RECALL < 0.50 -> REPAIR-LEAKY. F-CONTAIN (falsifies H-CONTAIN): M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT < 1.0 OR M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION > 0.0 -> REPAIR-OVERREACH, a bounded falsification of local containment on this substrate. F-MIXED: 0.70 < M_COST_RATIO < 1.0, or M_COST_RATIO <= 0.70 with a quality/containment shortfall not severe enough for F-QUALITY/F-CONTAIN -> INTERMEDIATE. Every terminal branch either emits a bounded C-DELTA-REPAIR statement (SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES/MIXED, all status=COMPLETE) or is a measurement-invalid/inconclusive state that is explicitly NOT a scientific negative (SB-08).

substrate.class: CONTROLLED, CREDENTIAL-FREE, STDLIB-ONLY, LOOPBACK-ONLY MULTI-NODE HTTP SUBSTRATE (no Flask/PyJWT/nginx/gunicorn/SQLite dependency)
substrate.why_this_class: The prior distributed attempt (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880) failed at health because its Flask+PyJWT+gunicorn+nginx substrate was not robustly startable in the environment. Design self-attack (SA-04) rejected any substrate requiring pip installs. The DESIGN satisfiability probe started N=3 independent stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer origins on ephemeral loopback ports and performed 18 successful reads observing 3 distinct node identities, so this class is proven startable before freeze.

nodes.implementation: three independent loopback HTTP origins (separate ThreadingHTTPServer instances/ports, each with its own local JSON registry file under a per-node temp directory), started by the EXECUTE runner; separate origins (not separate PIDs) define node identity
nodes.identity_surface: each node exposes /health -> {status, node_id, registry_sha256}; distinct node_id values and distinct registry paths plus distinct loopback ports are the multi-node identity evidence
nodes.knowledge: each node holds the inherited record subset assigned to it by the deterministic router key; the inherited corpus is R=24 records, 8 per node

router.implementation: stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer that deterministically maps a goal key (record_id; for ENDPOINT/TRANSPORT families a synthetic family key) to exactly one node
router.role: the system under test sees a single base URL; the router is the only client-facing entrypoint

substrate.credential_free: no Authorization header, no JWT, no cookie, no session, no credential of any kind is required or accepted; every scored request is an idempotent GET; no write verb is exposed to the system under test

perturbation_surface.controller: an out-of-band perturbation controller (NOT the system under test) mutates node registry files between episodes through a control channel the system under test cannot read or write
perturbation_surface.independent_verification: for every perturbation the controller retains the pre-mutation and post-mutation registry file sha256 for all N nodes and the node identity map; a verifier module that shares NO localization code with the treatment recomputes the TRUE blast radius (set of (node_id, record_id, field)) and the TRUE post-perturbation ground-truth value set from those retained snapshots
perturbation_surface.why_this_is_stronger_than_self_report: contamination, precision, recall, false-accept and blast-radius containment can all be scored against a ground truth the treatment did not produce and cannot see

FIELD.description: one field value on one record on one node changes; observable surface is a value mismatch on the served field. Includes a pre-registered surface-ambiguous sub-stratum.

ENDPOINT.description: the response schema of one record family on one node changes (field added, removed or retyped; path-normalization changes).

TRANSPORT.description: a node changes its validator semantics: ETag emitted from a different scheme, or If-None-Match handling changes so a stale body yields 304 (false-fresh) or a fresh body is served after a 304-triggering token.

LEGIT.description: LEGITIMATE-UPDATE CONTROL: a value changes through a pre-registered legitimate update channel; it MUST NOT be treated as requiring repair. Not a perturbation family for recall; scored for false-repair and contamination.

PERMISSION.reason: SB-02: permission/authority-boundary drift requires credentialed/authenticated state, which a credential-free substrate structurally forbids. The nearest reachable analogue (a node-local capability flag governing field visibility) is a strict subset of ENDPOINT and is therefore not admitted as a distinct family. Declared, not silently dropped.

substrate.ambiguity_design: Within FIELD, a pre-registered surface-ambiguous stratum presents the SAME primary observable signal (a changed value with shape-invariant schema and normal transport) for both a genuine perturbation and a LEGIT legitimate update. On this stratum the treatment cannot be definitionally certain from the primary signal; it must pay an additional disambiguation cost, abstain UNKNOWN, or risk false-repair/false-accept. This is what keeps the treatment below the oracle ceiling and makes the measured cost non-trivial (H-NONDEGENERATE).
substrate.ambiguity_resolution: Disambiguation is possible but not free: the substrate exposes a per-record provenance/version token on a secondary endpoint. A LEGIT legitimate update bumps the token; a genuine perturbation bypasses it (no bump). The treatment must spend one extra conditional read plus one verification (a bounded disambiguation cost) to read the token and resolve the ambiguity; a treatment that declines to pay it and repairs anyway incurs M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT/contamination, and one that abstains incurs lost recall. Only the surface-ambiguous FIELD sub-stratum and the LEGIT family require this token read; ENDPOINT, TRANSPORT and non-ambiguous FIELD perturbations present shape-distinct signals (schema/type/invariant violation) that require no disambiguation. This creates a genuine cost-vs-quality trade rather than an unresolvable stratum, so the SUPPORTS branch (perfect recall at bounded cost) and the FALSIFIES-QUALITY branch (leaky/abstaining arm) are both reachable.

scored_suite.pairing: every episode is scored by every arm on the identical scenario (paired design), so the cost ratio and its paired bootstrap are computed over matched episodes.
scored_suite.note: field_clean = 24-8 = 16; perturbed_clean_total = 16+12+12 = 40; suite = 40 clean perturbed + 8 ambiguous + 15 LEGIT + 9 NO_PERT = 72.

candidate_procedure_space.description: the frozen set of candidate endpoint/parameter templates an uninformed agent must search to re-derive a goal's procedure; B-COLD-REDERIVE searches this space, T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR inherits the correct member and does not search it. This is the substrate property that makes cold re-derivation cost real rather than definitional.

substrate.determinism: a single frozen seed (38087579015) drives all layout/scheduling/ambiguity/family assignment via random.Random(seed); Python process-randomized hash() is never used as a seed or layout key; registry files are canonical JSON with sorted keys
substrate.environment: CPython 3.12 stdlib only; Python 3.12.15 present in the design environment; no external network, no model, no browser, no credential, no pip install at EXECUTE time (V09)

treatment.description: Maintain per-node inherited knowledge plus a verifier. For each scored episode the treatment retrieves the inherited mechanism, binds and executes it, and verifies the observed postcondition with the frozen verification primitive (src.spider.kernel._matches). On a verified-consistent observation it stops. On a mismatch it localizes the affected node and minimal cell set (using the observable diff, plus bounded probes on the ambiguous stratum), re-fetches ONLY the affected item within the detected scope, applies a MINIMAL mutation to that node's local registry, re-verifies, and marks repaired on success. It never mutates a node outside the independently recomputed blast radius. On the ambiguous stratum it may pay a bounded disambiguation cost, abstain (UNKNOWN), or risk error; abstention is not a wrong answer but lowers recall.
treatment.verification_primitive: IMPORT AND USE VERBATIM src/spider/kernel.py symbols _matches, _bind, _template_slots (bound in freeze_artifacts). Both the treatment and the independent verifier MUST use _matches for postcondition equality and _bind for template instantiation, so that the frozen verification semantics are the exact bound artifact.
treatment.liveness_requirement: V11 treatment-liveness smoke test: before scoring, the treatment must execute end-to-end on one canary episode and produce a verifier-consistent repaired state; a structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), never a scientific negative.

counter_definitions.http_requests: each outbound HTTP request the system under test issues to the substrate (router or node) during a scored episode, counted at the client boundary.
counter_definitions.retrieval_calls: each distinct lookup into inherited knowledge (a local-registry read or a cross-node knowledge retrieval) during a scored episode.
counter_definitions.verification_calls: each independent verification pass over a candidate reconciled value (a re-fetch-and-compare or a verifier-oracle invocation) during a scored episode.
counter_definitions.repair_attempts: each mutation/apply attempt to a local registry (including rejected or rolled-back attempts) during a scored episode.
counter_definitions.aggregation: M_COST_VECTOR_X = element-wise sum of the four counters over all scored episodes for arm X; M_COST_L1_X = sum of the four components; M_COST_RATIO = M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE.
counter_definitions.instrumentation_consistency: client-boundary counters are cross-checked against raw per-request logs (V04); any discrepancy is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.note: Frozen identities shared verbatim with EXECUTE/AUDIT/DIRECTOR. All arms share the identical counter instrumentation and the identical scored episode set.

B-COLD-REDERIVE.description: HONEST per-goal cold re-derivation: for each scored episode, with an EMPTY inherited store, search the frozen candidate_procedure_space (size 8) to discover the goal's procedure, bind params, read the value and verify it. It is NOT forced to re-derive the entire corpus (that would be a strawman; see SA-08). This is the primary cost comparator.
B-COLD-REDERIVE.role: primary cost comparator for M_COST_RATIO and the honest work-avoided reference.

B-NOOP-STALE.description: Null comparator: serve inherited knowledge unchanged, with no detection and no repair.
B-NOOP-STALE.role: proves the contamination/false-accept metrics can detect failure (NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY).

B-FULL-REFRESH.description: Cost-ceiling comparator: on the first detected change in an episode, refresh the ENTIRE corpus (R=24 records over N=3 nodes).
B-FULL-REFRESH.role: realises the no-containment/no-localization cost extreme and makes the F-COST/FALSIFIES branch reachable; its local-registry mutation set exceeds the blast radius and is expected to fail F-CONTAIN.

B-LOCAL-ORACLE.description: Definitional floor: given the true delta, serve the answer and apply only the minimal mutations to the affected registry (no detection, no localization).
B-LOCAL-ORACLE.role: establishes the cost floor; used by PC-COST-CANARY to prove the counter instrument has dynamic range. NOT a scientific arm.

PC-DETECT-CANARY.requirement: On a pre-registered fully-observable FIELD canary episode, T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR must detect and repair the perturbation so that M_RECALL_FIELD on the canary == 1.0 and M_CANARY_PASS == true.
PC-DETECT-CANARY.why_it_is_a_real_control: A zero-recall treatment cannot be distinguished from an incapable instrument; the canary pins the instrument's ability to fire.

PC-COST-CANARY.requirement: On the same episode, M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE must be strictly greater than M_COST_L1_B-LOCAL-ORACLE; M_COST_SEPARATION_PASS == true.
PC-COST-CANARY.why_it_is_a_real_control: Proves the counter instrument separates real re-derivation work from minimal work; without it a flat cost_ratio cannot be interpreted.

PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS.requirement: On a synthetic fixture where the treatment is handed the exact delta, its output registry state must be byte-equal (canonical JSON) to the independently computed ground-truth state; M_REPAIR_FIXTURE_PASS == true.
PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS.why_it_is_a_real_control: A treatment that cannot even reproduce truth given the delta has a defective apply path; failure is a measurement failure, not a negative.

NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION.requirement: On a no-perturbation replicate, M_CONTAMINATION == 0, M_FALSE_ACCEPT == 0 and M_FALSE_REPAIR == 0 (the treatment makes no spurious mutations).
NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION.why: A treatment that mutates without cause corrupts the substrate.

NC-LEGIT-NO-REPAIR.requirement: On the LEGIT family, M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT <= 0.05: legitimate updates must not be classified as perturbations requiring repair.

NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY.requirement: On perturbed items B-NOOP-STALE must exhibit M_CONTAMINATION > the contamination bound (the metric detects failure), while B-COLD-REDERIVE must reach M_CONTAMINATION == 0 on the same items (the metric is not stuck).
NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY.why: A metric that cannot read both failure and success controls nothing.

NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE.requirement: The independently recomputed true blast radius and ground-truth value set must exactly match the perturbation controller's retained pre/post registry snapshots; the verifier shares no localization code path with the treatment; any mismatch is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT.requirement: Contamination, precision, recall and false-accept are computed by byte-exact comparison to the independently recomputed ground truth, never from the treatment's self-report.
NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT.why: Prevents a treatment from manufacturing its own success criterion.

metrics.M_COST_RATIO: M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE (primary cost metric; lower is better).
metrics.M_COST_RATIO_UPPER: paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound of the per-episode L1 ratio (paired over the identical scored suite).
metrics.M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR: sum of the four frozen counters for the treatment.
metrics.M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE: sum of the four frozen counters for honest per-goal cold re-derivation.
metrics.M_COST_L1_B-LOCAL-ORACLE: sum of the four frozen counters for the definitional floor (dynamic-range reference).
metrics.M_COST_L1_B-FULL-REFRESH: sum of the four frozen counters for the full-refresh cost extreme.
metrics.M_CONTAMINATION: fraction of all served answers (perturbed + LEGIT + no-perturbation items) that are byte-inexact versus independently recomputed ground truth.
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT: fraction of scored items where the treatment serves or preserves a stale/incorrect value while claiming a consistent/repaired state.
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT_FIELD: per-family false-accept on the FIELD family (reported; the mandate requires per-family false-accept).
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT_ENDPOINT: per-family false-accept on the ENDPOINT family.
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT_TRANSPORT: per-family false-accept on the TRANSPORT family.
metrics.M_PRECISION_FIELD: precision of the treatment's repair detections on the FIELD family.
metrics.M_PRECISION_ENDPOINT: precision of the treatment's repair detections on the ENDPOINT family.
metrics.M_PRECISION_TRANSPORT: precision of the treatment's repair detections on the TRANSPORT family.
metrics.M_RECALL_FIELD: recall on the FIELD family (genuine perturbations repaired / genuine perturbations).
metrics.M_FALSE_REPAIR: fraction of unperturbed items mutated by the treatment.
metrics.M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT: fraction of LEGIT (legitimate-update) items mutated by the treatment.
metrics.M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT: fraction of perturbations whose applied mutation set is a subset of the independently recomputed true blast radius.
metrics.M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION: fraction of perturbed episodes in which a node outside the true blast radius is mutated or serves a byte-inexact value attributable to the perturbation.
metrics.M_UNKNOWN_RATE: fraction of episodes where the treatment abstains (UNKNOWN) instead of repairing.

ordered.condition: all blocking measurement-validity checks pass (V02-V09, V11) and all three positive controls pass and all null controls are sensitive
ordered.consequence: no C-DELTA-REPAIR scientific statement; operational failure is not falsification (SB-08)

ordered.condition: M_COST_RATIO <= 0.70 AND M_COST_RATIO_UPPER < 1.0 AND M_CONTAMINATION <= 0.05 AND M_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.05 AND min(M_RECALL_FIELD, M_RECALL_ENDPOINT, M_RECALL_TRANSPORT) >= 0.90 AND M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT <= 0.05 AND M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT == 1.0 AND M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION == 0.0
ordered.consequence: bounded local-repair capability measured on the controlled multi-node substrate; C-DELTA-REPAIR's next gate is measured (status remains HYPOTHESIS, DIRECTOR decides any change)
local repair saves no work versus honest per-goal cold re-derivation on this substrate
cost work is not reliable repair
repair is not locally contained on this substrate

ordered.condition: otherwise (0.70 < M_COST_RATIO < 1.0, OR M_COST_RATIO <= 0.70 with a quality/containment shortfall not severe enough for FALSIFIES-QUALITY/FALSIFIES-CONTAIN)
ordered.consequence: partial save or partial reliability; bounded report, no capability claim

decision_rule.branch_reachability: Proven reachable pre-freeze in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run: SUPPORTS (witness cost_ratio ~0.664 with clean quality), FALSIFIES-COST (witness: a treatment that re-derives per goal -> ratio ~1.0; B-FULL-REFRESH realises the structural extreme at ratio ~4.64), FALSIFIES-QUALITY (leaky-arm witness contamination 0.236 / recall 0.333), FALSIFIES-CONTAIN (any out-of-radius mutation, realised by B-FULL-REFRESH which mutates all 24 records), and MIXED (witness cost_ratio 0.664 with contamination 0.12). No branch is empty.

pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.status: EXECUTED BY DESIGN on a stdlib probe only; NO substrate-under-test episode against the real treatment, NO confirmatory measurement, NO web, NO model, NO credential. It exercises the same counter arithmetic, decision thresholds and dynamic-range logic EXECUTE will freeze.
pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.probe_artifact: /tmp/opencode/probe_38087579015.py (design-local; not a scored artifact; inline outputs recorded below)

component_A_substrate_feasibility.detail: The probe started N=3 independent stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer loopback origins on ephemeral ports and performed 18 successful reads returning 3 distinct node identities (nodeA/nodeB/nodeC); stdlib_only=true. No Flask/PyJWT/nginx/gunicorn/SQLite/pip was required. This disproves the prior health-gate failure mode (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880) before EXECUTE exists.

component_B_primitives.detail: src.spider.kernel imported successfully; _matches({'field':1},{'field':1,'extra':2})==true; _matches({'field':1},{'field':2})==false; _bind('users/${uid}',{'uid':'7'})=='users/7'; _template_slots({'p':'${uid}'})=={'uid'}; kernel.py sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61 (the artifact bound in freeze_artifacts).

component_C_arithmetic.detail: Frozen cost model (illustrative witnesses, NOT predictions): base_serve=3 per episode (retrieve inherited mechanism + execute + verify); repair_unit=4 per mutated cell (re-fetch + retrieval + apply + verify); disambiguate=2 per ambiguous/legit episode (provenance token read + check); B-COLD-REDERIVE = procedure discovery over the frozen 8-member candidate space + read/verify ~= 11 per episode; B-FULL-REFRESH refreshes all 24 records on detection. Sum of blast radius over the 48 perturbed episodes (FIELD 24 at b=1, ENDPOINT 12 at b=1.5, TRANSPORT 12 at b=2) = 66. Aggregate witnesses: oracle floor (B-LOCAL-ORACLE serves + minimal repair) = 72*3 + 4*66 = 480 -> ratio 480/792 = 0.606; T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR = 72*3 + 4*66 + 2*23 = 526 -> ratio 526/792 = 0.664 (<=0.70 -> SUPPORTS reachable with clean quality); B-FULL-REFRESH = 48*(3+72) + 24*3 = 3672 -> ratio ~4.64; cold total = 72*11 = 792. The primary-metric range is therefore ~[0.61, ~4.64]; the SUPPORTS threshold 0.70 lies strictly above the floor 0.61 and strictly below the ceiling 4.64, so SUPPORTS is neither tautological nor unreachable, and the MIXED interval (0.70,1.0) and the FALSIFIES region (>=1.0) are non-empty.

component_C_bounds_non_vacuity.detail: Under the frozen metric definitions with n=72: a reachable PASS case gives M_CONTAMINATION 0.0 (Wilson upper ~0.051) and M_RECALL_FIELD 1.0; a reachable FAIL case gives M_CONTAMINATION 0.236 (17/72) and M_RECALL_FIELD 0.333. Both regions of every bound are arithmetically reachable, so the bounds are non-vacuous and discriminating.

branch_reachability_matrix.GATE-V_MEASUREMENT_INVALID: reachable (substrate start failure, counter mismatch, verifier mismatch, control-channel leak, liveness failure)
branch_reachability_matrix.SUPPORTS: reachable (witness cost_ratio 0.664 with clean quality and perfect containment)
branch_reachability_matrix.FALSIFIES-COST: reachable (a re-derive-per-goal treatment ratio ~1.0; B-FULL-REFRESH cost_ratio ~4.64)
branch_reachability_matrix.FALSIFIES-CONTAIN: reachable (B-FULL-REFRESH mutates all 24 records > blast radius; or any out-of-radius mutation)
branch_reachability_matrix.MIXED: reachable (cost_ratio 0.664 with contamination 0.12; or cost in (0.70,1.0))

estimator_control_fixture.note: The primary cost metric uses a paired bootstrap over episodes; the analogous non-vacuity guarantee is the dynamic-range control PC-COST-CANARY (B-COLD-REDERIVE strictly above B-LOCAL-ORACLE) plus the contamination PASS/FAIL witnesses above. Declared explicitly so AUDIT does not look for an unused estimator control.

self_attack_findings.finding: The first-drafted decision rule's MIXED reachability check ignored the 'cost win but quality fails' subcase and reported MIXED unreachable.
self_attack_findings.resolution: MIXED redefined as 'otherwise', explicitly including cost_ratio<=0.70 with a quality/containment shortfall; a witness (cost_ratio 0.664, contamination 0.12) is recorded.

self_attack_findings.finding: The mandate names 'permission' as a blast-radius-1-3 change, but permission drift is structurally unreachable on a credential-free substrate.
self_attack_findings.resolution: PERMISSION declared NOT_APPLICABLE with reason SB-02; the nearest analogue (node-local capability flag governing field visibility) is a strict subset of ENDPOINT, so it is not admitted as a distinct family. No silent drop.

self_attack_findings.finding: A deterministic substrate that hands the treatment the exact delta collapses repair to the oracle (repair==truth, contamination==0), reproducing the EXP-GRAPH-36018188168 single-node definitional ceiling and making precision/recall trivial.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Added a pre-registered surface-ambiguous FIELD stratum (genuine perturbation and legitimate update share the same observably changed signal) and a LEGIT control family; the treatment must pay to disambiguate, abstain or risk error, so it cannot be at the oracle ceiling and the cost metric is non-trivial.

self_attack_findings.finding: Any substrate requiring pip-installed Flask/PyJWT/gunicorn/nginx reproduces the EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 MEASUREMENT_INVALID health-gate failure.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Design fixed to stdlib-only loopback HTTP origins; a pre-freeze probe started 3 independent origins successfully without any install.

self_attack_findings.finding: Contamination/containment scored from treatment self-report would let the treatment define its own success.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Added NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT and NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE: an independent verifier recomputes ground truth and blast radius from retained pre/post registry snapshots by byte-exact comparison.

self_attack_findings.finding: The frozen numeric cost threshold 0.70 could have been set below the definitional floor, making SUPPORTS tautological, or above the ceiling, making it unreachable.
self_attack_findings.resolution: The probe fixes the oracle floor 0.606 and the B-FULL-REFRESH ceiling ~4.64 with the threshold 0.70 strictly inside the open interval; both SUPPORTS (0.664) and FALSIFIES-COST (>=1.0) are reachable.

self_attack_findings.finding: freeze_artifacts could not bind EXECUTE-written runner/substrate/verifier code because those files do not exist at freeze and the DESIGN write scope forbids creating them (the same defect the predecessor EXP-GRAPH-38085175893 declared NOT_APPLICABLE).
self_attack_findings.resolution: Rather than declare NOT_APPLICABLE, the design now has a genuine pre-existing interpretation dependency: the frozen verification primitive src/spider/kernel.py (imported verbatim by both treatment and verifier). freeze_artifacts binds that exact file (freeze_artifacts_bound=PASS); the not-yet-existing EXECUTE code files are additionally enumerated in spec.code_binding and MUST be hashed into result.json.artifacts/provenance.json at EXECUTE. The residual scripts/ code-binding limitation is declared, not hidden.

self_attack_findings.finding: The predecessor compared the treatment against a comparator forced to re-derive the ENTIRE 24-record corpus for one goal, which is a strawman and makes the cost ratio near-definitional (b/R).
self_attack_findings.resolution: B-COLD-REDERIVE redefined as an HONEST per-goal re-derivation: it discovers the minimal procedure+parameters for the SAME goal from the frozen 8-member candidate space and reads the value, exactly as an agent with no inheritance would. The comparison is therefore discovery-vs-repair, its magnitude is measured (not defined by R/b), and FALSIFIES-COST is behaviourally reachable.

self_attack_findings.finding: Conflating inheritance benefit with repair benefit could credit delta-repair for a work saving produced merely by inheriting a procedure.
self_attack_findings.resolution: B-NOOP-STALE is the inherit-without-repair ablation: it has the same inheritance as the treatment and none of the repair. The causal reading requires treatment to beat B-NOOP-STALE on contamination AND beat B-COLD-REDERIVE on cost, so the repair action is isolated.

pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.no_outcome_claim: The probe measures no repair behaviour of the real treatment and cannot pre-empt the confirmatory objects (cost ratio, contamination, precision/recall, containment). It only proves feasibility and arithmetic reachability.

measurement_validity.requirement: This spec and prereg.md are written before any substrate episode. DESIGN performed no confirmatory measurement: no substrate-under-test perturbation against the real treatment, no treatment evaluation. The only DESIGN computation is the synthetic stdlib satisfiability probe.
measurement_validity.why: Research 2.0 packet contract and architecture section 5.

measurement_validity.requirement: At EXECUTE start, verify N=3 node origins are alive with distinct node_id values, distinct registry paths and distinct loopback ports, and the router health endpoint returns a routed read; any failure is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID (not a scientific negative).
measurement_validity.why: The prior distributed failure was a health-gate infrastructure failure; fail closed, not open.

measurement_validity.requirement: Retain pre/post registry sha256 for all nodes and independently recompute the true blast radius and ground-truth value set; a verifier/treatment code-path mismatch is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Containment and contamination must rest on independently recomputed ground truth.

measurement_validity.requirement: Client-boundary counters are cross-checked against raw per-request logs; any discrepancy is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Cost is the primary metric; its instrument must be internally consistent.

measurement_validity.requirement: The system under test cannot read or write the perturbation controller's ledger or control channel (verified by isolation attestation); the treatment never receives the true delta on the scored population.
measurement_validity.why: Otherwise the treatment could read the ground truth and collapse to the oracle.

measurement_validity.requirement: Retain all episode request/response records, per-node registry snapshots (pre/post every perturbation), counter logs and the independent ground-truth recomputation; the whole measurement must be re-analyzable without re-running.
measurement_validity.why: The prior distributed failure was unrecoverable because evidence was not retained.

measurement_validity.requirement: A single frozen seed (38087579015) drives all layout/scheduling/ambiguity/family assignment via random.Random(seed); Python process-randomized hash() is never used as a seed or layout key.

Re-verify request.json/spec.json/prereg.md against freeze.json sha256 before the first episode and after the last; re-verify src/spider/kernel.py against freeze.json.artifact_hashes; hash every producer source file into result.json.artifacts (role 'code') and provenance.json.

The substrate is local loopback only; every scored request is an idempotent GET; no credential, token, cookie, session, browser or external network is used; no write verb is exposed to the system under test. Violation is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Keeps the substrate reproducible and independent of unavailable external services/credentials.

measurement_validity.requirement: Each gated bound must have both a reachable PASS and a reachable FAIL region, documented in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run; the support threshold must lie strictly above the definitional floor and strictly below the full-refresh ceiling.
measurement_validity.why: Prevents a tautological or unreachable decision.

measurement_validity.requirement: Before scoring, the treatment must complete one canary episode end-to-end with a verifier-consistent repaired state.
measurement_validity.why: A structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure, not a scientific negative.

measurement_validity.requirement: Record explicitly that this experiment is a DISTINCT_EXTENSION from the pre-2.0 repair-round artifacts (which repaired rejected experiment runs / orchestration, not inherited Web knowledge), from the prior R2 single-node and distributed delta-repair packets, and from the pre-freeze predecessor EXP-GRAPH-38085175893 (never frozen, never executed; this design changes the measured object to honest per-goal cold re-derivation and binds a real pre-existing artifact).
measurement_validity.why: Prevents re-running an identical or already-closed design.

code_binding.freeze_time_existing_dependencies: src/spider/kernel.py (sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61) is the frozen verification/binding primitive; it is bound in spec.freeze_artifacts and hashed into freeze.json.artifact_hashes and is immutable for the transaction. It is the ONLY pre-existing mutable local dependency on which the interpretation rests.

planned_execute_code_files_must_be_hashe.purpose: episode runner, treatment, comparators, counter instrumentation
stdlib node origins + deterministic router + per-node registries
out-of-band perturbation controller and independent verifier

code_binding.requirement: EXECUTE MUST hash each produced file (sha256) into result.json.artifacts with role 'code' or 'fixture' and into provenance.json; the independent auditor recomputes these hashes. Those files do not exist at freeze time and the DESIGN write scope forbids DESIGN from creating them, so they cannot be listed in spec.freeze_artifacts (the freezer rejects non-existent paths). This residual code-binding limitation (the defect lives in scripts/, outside every lane's allowed_code_roots) is declared. The pre-existing verification primitive src/spider/kernel.py IS bound now.
code_binding.at_execute_also_reuse_unchanged: The frozen request.json/spec.json/prereg.md/design_review.json, the frozen seed, and src/spider/kernel.py; no external data.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every ordered branch is reachable and non-empty, proven in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run: SUPPORTS (witness cost_ratio 0.664 with clean quality), FALSIFIES-COST (>=1.0, reachable by a re-derive-per-goal treatment at ~1.0 and realised by B-FULL-REFRESH at ~4.64), FALSIFIES-QUALITY (contamination 0.236 / recall 0.333), FALSIFIES-CONTAIN (B-FULL-REFRESH or any out-of-radius mutation), MIXED (cost win with quality shortfall, witness cost_ratio 0.664 / contamination 0.12). GATE-V is reachable via the enumerated validity failures. The support threshold 0.70 lies strictly above the oracle floor 0.606 and below the ceiling, so SUPPORTS is neither tautological nor unreachable. Self-attack SA-01 fixed the earlier MIXED mis-specification and SA-08 removed the previous definitional comparator.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All prerequisites exist now and are local: CPython 3.12 stdlib only (no Flask/PyJWT/nginx/gunicorn/SQLite/pip install), loopback networking, ephemeral ports, and the frozen verification primitive. The DESIGN probe already started N=3 independent stdlib loopback origins (18 reads, 3 distinct identities) and imported/executed the kernel primitives, so the substrate class and the treatment's verification semantics are proven available before freeze. No external network, model, credential, browser, task bank or dataset is required. The treatment-liveness smoke test (V11) is a pre-scoring smoke, not a deferred prerequisite for the design's satisfiability.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The compared pair is identifiable and not collapsed: B-COLD-REDERIVE is an HONEST per-goal re-derivation (discovers the goal's procedure from the 8-member candidate space and reads the value) and the treatment inherits that procedure and pays detection+repair; the two differ in a measured quantity (procedure discovery vs detection/localization/repair), not by construction of R/b. B-LOCAL-ORACLE (oracle floor 0.606) and B-FULL-REFRESH (no-localization extreme, ratio ~4.64) bracket the dynamic range, and PC-COST-CANARY requires cold strictly above oracle, so the primary metric has non-zero variance and range. The primary metric (M_COST_RATIO) is not at ceiling for either compared arm; the treatment is deliberately kept below the correctness oracle by the ambiguous stratum, and B-NOOP-STALE isolates the inheritance-without-repair ablation so the repair contribution is identified.

control_sensitivity.reason: Every control has a pre-declared firing/abstaining outcome and pre-declared pass/fail arithmetic computed by the SAME treatment/counter code that scores the question: PC-DETECT-CANARY requires canary recall == 1.0; PC-COST-CANARY requires cold > oracle strictly; PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS requires byte-equal output on a given-delta fixture; NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION requires contamination/false-repair == 0; NC-LEGIT-NO-REPAIR requires false-repair <= 0.05; NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY requires B-NOOP-STALE contamination > bound AND B-COLD-REDERIVE contamination == 0 on the same items; NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE requires an exact independent recompute. Both PASS and FAIL regions of every bound are arithmetically reachable (component_C_bounds_non_vacuity). The controls are not tautological: they operate on canary/legitimate/synthetic fixtures with pre-declared expectations.

treatment_liveness.reason: The decision-relevant treatment T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR is a concrete, executable program: retrieve the router-keyed node/record, bind+execute the inherited mechanism via src.spider.kernel._bind, verify via _matches, localize the minimal cell set, re-fetch the affected item, apply a minimal registry mutation, re-verify. Design proven satisfiable: the probe demonstrated the substrate the treatment needs (3 independent stdlib origins, 18 successful reads) and the exact verification primitives (_matches/_bind/_template_slots) it will use. V11 mandates a pre-scoring liveness smoke test; a structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), not a scientific result. No branch of the decision rule is structurally empty for the treatment.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: The interpretation rests on exactly one pre-existing mutable local dependency: the verification/binding primitive src/spider/kernel.py (sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61), which both the treatment and the independent verifier MUST import and use verbatim (_matches, _bind, _template_slots). It is listed in spec.freeze_artifacts and is hashed by the freezer into freeze.json.artifact_hashes, making its identity immutable for the transaction. No other pre-existing mutable local code/data/task-bank/fixture is an interpretation dependency. The only remaining mutable dependencies are the EXECUTE-authored producer files (runner, substrate, perturbation controller/verifier, fixtures), which do not exist at freeze because the DESIGN write scope (scripts/check_scope.py stage 'design') allows only spec.json/prereg.md/design_review.json/failure.json/model_design.json/model_design_review.json and forbids creating code; scripts/freeze_experiment.py.safe_repo_file rejects non-existent paths, so they cannot be listed. They are enumerated in spec.code_binding and MUST be hashed into result.json.artifacts (role 'code'/'fixture') and provenance.json at EXECUTE. This residual code-binding limitation is the same one the Director's rationale acknowledges (the defect lives in scripts/, outside every lane's allowed_code_roots); it is declared rather than hidden. Self-attack SA-07 upgraded this check from the predecessor's NOT_APPLICABLE to a real bound artifact.

legacy_distinctness.pre_2_0_archive: The indexed pre-2.0 graph repair artifacts (results/graph/cycle3_REPAIR_ROUND1_recount.json sha256 f2239dd8dfb2f4744895bb9c3a6495646cfab31c; results/graph/fused_REPAIR_ROUND1_recount.json sha256 c7a052ea28929a9a62813b230480118d209eccde; reports/graph/robustness_repair_round1.md sha256 032c11f915eb4b235f2cba0fd907f9a81a0122b7; reports/graph/procedure_compilation_p0.md sha256 12eac599c2e907e442f74d48625bf404b259a74f) concern repairing REJECTED EXPERIMENT RUNS / orchestration and procedure compilation, not local delta repair of inherited Web knowledge under controlled perturbations. This experiment is therefore a DISTINCT_EXTENSION, matching the Director's comparative_reasoning and the mandate's legacy classification.
legacy_distinctness.r2_predecessors: EXP-GRAPH-35952148696 (synthetic single-resource blast radius 1; inherited synthetic ceiling) and EXP-GRAPH-36018188168 (single-node deterministic substrate; contamination 0.0, repair 1.0 definitional ceiling) measured single-node repair; EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 (distributed) was MEASUREMENT_INVALID at the health gate; EXP-GRAPH-38085175893 (pre-freeze predecessor for this same mandate) was never frozen and never executed, and its primary comparator re-derived the whole corpus (definitional). This experiment changes the measured object to a MULTI-NODE repair-cost and contamination-bound read with an honest per-goal cold re-derivation comparator and an independently verifiable perturbation surface, avoiding both the single-node definitional ceiling (via the surface-ambiguous stratum and LEGIT control) and the prior health-gate failure (via a stdlib-only substrate proven startable pre-freeze).
legacy_distinctness.not_a_rerun: It does not repeat the SPIDER_CODEX_ULTIME repair-round recounts, does not contact web anchors, does not re-litigate C-FRESHNESS D1V, does not import the failed distributed packet's leaked defaults, and does not re-issue the never-frozen EXP-GRAPH-38085175893 design unchanged.

scope_boundaries.SB-01: Every result is bounded to the frozen controlled substrate (N=3 stdlib origins, R=24 records, blast radius 1-3, the frozen family set, the frozen candidate procedure space, the single frozen seed). No Web-prevalence or 'the Web' statement.
scope_boundaries.SB-02: PERMISSION-family repairability is NOT_APPLICABLE on this credential-free substrate; the mandate's 'permission' clause is declared unreachable, not silently dropped.
scope_boundaries.SB-03: No external network, model, credential, browser or task bank is used; all evidence is local.
scope_boundaries.SB-04: Only C-DELTA-REPAIR is addressed; no other claim event may be emitted.
scope_boundaries.SB-05: No Product Core promotion and no shipped-status change; only the DIRECTOR may change claim status.
scope_boundaries.SB-06: No claim that repair generalizes beyond blast radius 1-3 or beyond the frozen families.
scope_boundaries.SB-07: The substrate is synthetic/controlled; this is not real-Web verification.
scope_boundaries.SB-08: MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE is an operational state, never a scientific falsification of C-DELTA-REPAIR.
scope_boundaries.SB-09: DISTINCT_EXTENSION from the pre-2.0 repair-round artifacts, the prior R2 single-node/distributed packets, and the never-frozen predecessor EXP-GRAPH-38085175893.
scope_boundaries.SB-10: Single environment and single seed; no amortization-over-population or prevalence claim.
scope_boundaries.SB-11: The bound artifact src/spider/kernel.py is used only for its verification/binding semantics; binding it does not claim any kernel capability (in particular it does not address blocker B1 about literal distill()).

product_consequence_positive: If SUPPORTS: C-DELTA-REPAIR's registry next gate ('controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds') is measured on a multi-node substrate for the first time in R2, giving the Product/Runtime lanes a bounded, auditable work-avoided ratio versus honest per-goal cold re-derivation and a contamination/false-accept envelope for local delta repair. This is decision-relevant input to whether delta-repair instrumentation is worth building at all. It does NOT by itself authorize any Product Core promotion, shipping, or status change (SB-05); the DIRECTOR decides bounded status movement from the frozen packet plus independent audit.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIES or MIXED: the Product/Runtime lanes learn that on a controlled credential-free multi-node substrate, local delta repair either saves no work versus honest cold re-derivation (FALSIFIES-COST), is not reliable enough to be a safeguard (FALSIFIES-QUALITY), or is not locally contained (FALSIFIES-CONTAIN). That is a decisive negative for funding a delta-repair mechanism on the strength of the prior single-node positive, and it redirects effort away from repair instrumentation toward the already-identified critical path (the shipped parameterized carrier / non-degenerate benchmark). A MEASUREMENT_INVALID result carries NO scientific consequence and must be fixed at the control-plane/substrate level, not read as a repair negative (SB-08).
estimated_cost: Low. Stdlib-only, loopback-only, no model/browser/credential/network: 72 scored episodes x 2 primary arms plus 3 control baselines and fixtures, all in-process. Indicative compute is well under one CPU-minute and a few MB of raw JSON evidence; the main cost is EXECUTE implementation effort, not runtime or external spend.
expected_information_gain: HIGH and decision-changing: it converts C-DELTA-REPAIR's unmeasured registry next gate into a first controlled multi-node measurement with honest counters, an independent verifier, per-family precision/recall, and reachable SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES/MIXED branches. A SUPPORTS result justifies building delta-repair instrumentation; a FALSIFIES result closes the prior single-node positive as non-transferable and redirects effort to the critical path. Either way the outcome changes a product decision, and the design removes the two known degeneracies (single-node oracle ceiling; definitional whole-corpus comparator).
design_improvements_over_predecessor: Primary comparator changed from whole-corpus re-derivation (near-definitional, b/R) to HONEST per-goal cold re-derivation over a frozen 8-member candidate procedure space, so the measured cost ratio reflects a real discovery-vs-repair trade and FALSIFIES-COST is behaviourally reachable (SA-08).

freeze_artifacts_bound upgraded from NOT_APPLICABLE/[] to PASS with a real pre-existing bound artifact (src/spider/kernel.py, the verification primitive imported verbatim by treatment and verifier), eliminating the predecessor's unbound-verification-semantics gap (SA-07).
Added an explicit inheritance-without-repair ablation (B-NOOP-STALE) as the isolating control so a cost saving from inheritance alone cannot be credited to delta repair (SA-09).

Pre-freeze satisfiability certificate re-run and recorded inline with concrete outputs (substrate 18 reads/3 identities; kernel primitives true/false; arithmetic oracle floor 0.606, B-FULL-REFRESH ceiling ~4.64, threshold 0.70, SUPPORTS witness 0.664).
